items.statement: The autonomous investigation proposes and executes a finite candidate-generation rule spanning the crystallographically distinct oxygen environments, with explicit deduplication and coverage accounting.
items.expected: Candidate identities, generation and deduplication rules, and generated/compared counts are reported without relying on an undisclosed paper route.

items.statement: The candidate comparison applies consistent optimization and validates convergence, composition, charge, structural integrity and energy-reference consistency.
items.expected: Per-candidate validation context and method details support the reported comparison.

items.statement: The source-supported intermediate VO2(B) protonation regime has favorable (negative) formation energies through x=0.75, whereas x=1.0 has no stable configuration in the reported finite search.
items.expected: The conclusion supports favorable H0.25 energetics and states the finite-search limitation around full protonation, or reports bounded failure honestly.

items.statement: The source identifies O1(2TM) as the dominant favorable VO2(B) proton-binding environment, with O4(3TM) participating at higher concentration.
items.expected: The independently derived interpretation identifies the O1(2TM) environment as favored and discusses alternatives/limitations.
